test_title: PYST 3: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.**

I keep telling myself __how I am lucky to have__ such wonderful sisters.

options.text: how lucky I am to have
how lucky I am to having
how I am lucky for having

solution:
The correct sentence is "**how lucky I am to have**".
